title: Senores Pharma Subsidiary Secures Ukraine GMP Certification for Gujarat Manufacturing Facility

contentHtml:
Ahmedabad: Senores Pharmaceuticals Limited has announced that its subsidiary, Ratnatris Pharmaceuticals Private Limited, has received Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) certification under the Pharmaceutical Inspection Co-operation Scheme (PIC/S) for its manufacturing facility located in Mehsana, Gujarat.

The certification was granted by the State Service of Ukraine on Medicines and Drugs Control (SMDC), according to a regulatory filing submitted by the company.

The company informed the stock exchanges that the GMP compliance certificate was issued by the Ukrainian regulatory authority on November 16, 2026, and was received by the company on November 17, 2026.

With this certification, Senores Pharmaceuticals, through its subsidiary Ratnatris Pharmaceuticals, has expanded its pathway to pursue regulatory approvals across semi-regulated markets. The development is expected to support the company’s efforts to strengthen its regulatory presence and explore opportunities in additional international pharmaceutical markets.

The certification covers the manufacturing facility of Ratnatris Pharmaceuticals Private Limited in Mehsana, Gujarat. The recognition under the PIC/S GMP framework marks an important regulatory development for the subsidiary’s manufacturing operations.

Senores Pharmaceuticals Limited is headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.
